newsitem.title: USA: MidAmerican delays 515 MW Iowa unit restart.
newsitem.headline: MidAmerican delays 515 MW Iowa unit restart.

text.p: MidAmerican Energy Co delayed the startup of its 515 megawatt (MW) Neal coal-fired power unit 3 near Sioux City, Iowa, until Thursday following repair of a boiler tube leak, a company spokesman said.
"It's not back up yet, but we expect it will be back in the next few hours," spokesman John McCarroll said Thursday.
The unit, located 15 miles south of Sioux City, was shut Tuesday. The company originally said the unit was likely to restart production on Wednesday.
MidAmerican is the operator and has about a 72 percent interest in Neal unit 3, with IES Industries Inc subsidiary IES Utilities holding about 28 percent.
